# NFL Daily — 2026-09-09 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers agreed to a three-year, $165M contract extension ($55M/year), getting the deal done just before the season. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/baker-mayfield-buccaneers-contract-extension/)
- Raiders TE Brock Bowers had a meniscus trim and is expected to miss "a game or two," starting with Sunday's opener. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49884014/sources-brock-bowers-knee-miss-least-raiders-opener)
- 49ers DT Alfred Collins tore his patellar tendon at Tuesday's practice and is out for the season. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7577109/2026/09/08/49ers-alfred-collins-out-for-season-torn-patella/)
- Browns QB Deshaun Watson will make his first regular-season start since October 2024 Sunday against the Jaguars. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49881629/browns-deshaun-watson-set-first-start-2024-season)
- Vikings named Carson Wentz the No. 2 QB behind Kyler Murray for Week 1, dropping J.J. McCarthy to third string. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49883304/vikings-say-mccarthy-no-3-qb-wentz-no-2-week-1)
- Giants WR Malik Nabers was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, putting him on track to meet his Week 1 return goal. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2097769221316850171)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Cowboys G Tyler Smith was placed on injured reserve and will miss a minimum of four games. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/transactions)
- Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday's practice and is questionable for Sunday's opener. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-09-09 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Ravens WR Rashod Bateman spoke publicly for the first time since his June arrest on a family violence battery charge, saying he's "looking forward to playing football" and is still waiting to hear on possible discipline.
